_comment: The supervisor is not a worker agent and is deliberately NOT in agents.json: no role may be assigned to it, and it must not appear in the agent picker. It is the conversational layer that drives the orchestrator on the human's behalf.
role: conversational supervisor -- talks to the human, drives the orchestrator, never edits code
permission_flag: --permission-prompts none (allowlist, NOT bypassPermissions -- the supervisor has no write tools at all)
